asr_text: Elle listed mini bags as one of the trends in fall and winter 2026 fashion. Its examples included the Kite brand's palm-sized evening clutch and Chanel's novelty minaudiere. They mainly hold the basics: a phone, wallet, keys and lip products. They do not challenge roomy bags on storage. Their job is visual, adding a sense of occasion and saying, 'This is today's mood.' The season's picture becomes clearer when we look at what appeared beside them.
